what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Uzbekistan, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's figure for people displaced by conflict and violence was 3400 in every year from 2009 to 2014, the last year with a figure.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Uzbekistan: over the government, with JIG, in 2004.
IDMC's disaster records for Uzbekistan list floods.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2014.
IDMC has no conflict figure for Uzbekistan after 2014.

how.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 360 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Uzbekistan.
